name: Hag’s Ride
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [evil, mind-affecting]; Level sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 6

DESCRIPTION

As nightmare, except that it also opens a connection through which you can rend the target’s flesh.

After being damaged, the target wakes up but is paralyzed. At the start of each round, they can make a new Will save to shake off the paralysis. If they fail, they are dealt 1d10 damage.

The wounds appear visibly on the creature’s paralyzed form, but there are otherwise no outward signs of their torment. Ending the paralysis (including with remove paralysis or other magic) ends the effects of this spell.
